en: A multi-view vintage postcard with several small colored illustrations of landmarks in Budapest arranged on a black background. The central bottom area has the word "Budapest." in red. The small views include the Fisherman's Bastion (Fischerbastei / Halász-Bástya), the Gellért monument (Szent Gellért szobor – Gellhardus Monument), the Margaret Bridge (Margit híd – Margarethen-Brücke), Buda Castle area and surrounding structures including the castle bazaar (Ybl-bazár, Burgbazaar), Matthias Church / Matthias stairs (Mátyáslépcső – Matyásstiege), the Franz Joseph Bridge (Ferenc József híd – Franz Josef-Brücke), and an equestrian statue on a high plinth. The texts are in a mix of Hungarian and German, written in decorative script next to or over each vignette.
